baseline_reproduction_gate.reference_concordant_definition: The W00/P00/seed0 selected/not-selected state equals the frozen primary-source observational reference role.
baseline_reproduction_gate.mismatch_policy: Preserve and report; do not force concordance or replace the event.
baseline_reproduction_gate.robustness_transition_eligibility: Only REFERENCE_CONCORDANT events enter denominators requiring a reproduced classification baseline.

classification_transition_definitions.SELECTION_LOST: Reference-concordant baseline selected; variant not selected.
classification_transition_definitions.NOT_SELECTED_RETAINED: Reference-concordant baseline not selected; variant not selected.
classification_transition_definitions.SELECTION_GAINED: Reference-concordant baseline not selected; variant selected.
classification_transition_definitions.INPUT_INADMISSIBLE: Variant cannot be evaluated under the frozen admissibility contract.
classification_transition_definitions.INCOMPLETE_NUMERICAL: Input is admissible but required model outputs are incomplete/unavailable.
classification_transition_definitions.REFERENCE_BASELINE_MISMATCH: W00/P00/seed0 is evaluable but disagrees with the frozen source observational role.

denominators.planned_event_count: All events frozen by the F3A.2 cohort materialization contract, including later inadmissible/mismatched events.
denominators.cell_eligible_count: For each of 78 cells, number of planned events with admissible input and complete numerical output in that cell.
denominators.cell_transition_count: For each cell, number of events that are REFERENCE_CONCORDANT at W00/P00/seed0 and have an admissible/complete result in that cell.
denominators.classification_concordance_fraction_amon: Within each event or prespecified stratum, numerator = eligible primary cells whose selected/not-selected state equals W00/P00/seed0; denominator = eligible/complete primary cells for events with REFERENCE_CONCORDANT baseline. Report denominator beside every fraction.
denominators.inadmissible_fraction: INPUT_INADMISSIBLE count / planned primary variants, separately by reason and stratum.
denominators.incomplete_numerical_fraction: INCOMPLETE_NUMERICAL count / variants admissible for AFINO, separately by model/stratum where appropriate.

period_outcome.eligibility: baseline selected AND variant selected AND both selected M1 periods available
period_outcome.formal_m1_center_not_selected: Stored as numerical diagnostic only; never recoded as recovered period.

analysis_plan.primary: Descriptive transition and admissibility summaries across all 78 frozen cells, stratified by primary observational reference role.
secondary: period-change summaries conditional on retained selection
analysis_plan.multiplicity_policy: No inferential p-value family is planned; all 78 cells and denominators are reported, so no data-driven cell selection or multiplicity-adjusted significance claim is authorized.
planned_tables: 78-cell eligibility and classification-transition table by reference role
Window-family and processing-profile marginal summaries with planned/eligible denominators
Period-change summary restricted to selected-selected comparable variants
Numerical stability summary for W00/P00 seeds 0-9
planned_figures: Complete 13×6 classification-concordance/eligibility heatmaps by reference role; no cell may be omitted based on result.
Period-change distribution for prespecified eligible selected-selected contrasts.
Seed-stability diagnostic at W00/P00 with classification/BIC/period ranges.
